about: Budgets for scripts/perf-measure.sh, compared by scripts/perf-budget.py in the Performance budget job (#853). Every metric is lower-is-better. baseline is the number a budget was set from; budget is the most a pull request may measure. Raising a budget is a reviewed change: say why in the pull request. Both architectures take their baselines from one CI run on GitHub runners (run 44537224816). Image sizes get 10%. Startup and memory vary between machines, so their budgets sit at about two and a half times and one and a half times the number seen. Sizes are MB, startup is seconds until the server answers 200 for a built static file (not a page render, since no page can render without a CMS in this job), memory is the server resident MB after 60 s idle.
